dimension_c_md.title: Update Payment Record queryReplacement uses .item.json.reason instead of .first().json.reason — minor node-context inconsistency
dimension_c_md.evidence: WF-34.md:71 — queryReplacement: ={{ [$json.payment_id, $('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.reason || 'Payment not verified'] }}. All other trigger reads in this workflow use .first().json. In a single-item executeWorkflow trigger, .item and .first() are functionally equivalent, but inconsistent style.
